newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana-Pacific to close Idaho plant.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana-Pacific to close Idaho plant.

text.p: Louisiana-Pacific Corp said Friday it will close its oriented strand board plant in Chilco, Idaho on July 10.

It said the majority of employees at the plant have been on layoff since January and were told in early May that the layoffs could be indefinite. The company was not immediately available to say how many people will be affected by the plant closing. But it said it is continuing to "explore product innovations which could provide future opportunities for the plant."
"Market conditions due to U.S. and Canadian over-production of commodity board have weakened the plant's ability to compete," said Jim Lake, operations manager for the plant.
